description: This Java class 'EcuDefinitionInheritanceList' provides static methods to extract a list of inheritance 'rom' nodes from an ECU definition XML document. It appears to support parsing and retrieving inheritance chains based on CAL IDs, utilizing XPath for XML querying.

classes.name: EcuDefinitionInheritanceList
classes.description: Provides static utility methods to parse ECU inheritance XML data.

methods.name: getInheritanceList
methods.description: Returns a list of XML 'Node' elements representing the inheritance chain starting from the given ECU definition, traversing until a 'BASE' element is encountered.

methods.name: getBaseRomId
methods.description: Retrieves the CAL ID of the parent ROM based on the provided CAL ID code.

methods.name: getBaseRomIdNode
methods.description: Finds and returns the XML 'rom' node element that contains the specified CAL ID.
